Q: The map of Latin America below shows several cities and the available driving routes between them. Each arrow indicates a one-way driving connection from one city to another, and is labeled with the typical driving time in hours. What is the minimum total driving time, in hours, from the start city to the end city?

Work through it in this order:
1. For each region, write down which regions it shares a border with.
2. Read that list back before you use it: every pair should appear twice, once from each side. If one appears only once, you misread that border, so settle it before going on.
3. Try two colours. Give one region the first colour, give everything bordering it the second, and carry on across the picture. If two regions that share a border end up with the same colour, two is not enough.
4. When a number fails, add one more colour and try again the same way. Report the smallest number that works.

When you have finished reasoning, state your final answer on the last line as a single integer.
